prediction.raw: 1. You are the asshole for lying to your boyfriend and letting him believe his ex cheated on him. While your intention might have been to help him move on and feel better, lying is not an acceptable way to achieve this. By deceiving him, you've manipulated his perception of reality and potentially damaged his ability to process his emotions and come to terms with the breakup in a healthy way. Your actions, although possibly well-intentioned, have consequences. If your boyfriend were to find out the truth, he might feel betrayed by your lie, which could damage the trust in your relationship. Trust is a fundamental aspect of any relationship, and once broken, it can be challenging to repair. It's also important to consider the potential harm to your boyfriend's emotional well-being. By confirming his suspicions of cheating, you may have prevented him from working through his feelings and gaining closure in a genuine way. This could lead to unresolved emotions and potentially affect his ability to form healthy relationships in the future. Honesty, even if difficult, is usually the best policy in relationships. It would have been better to have an open and honest conversation with your boyfriend about his feelings and concerns, rather than resorting to deception.
